_comment: The format a clock with none written draws, by its mode. The project schema
decides it (UIElement.BLANK_FROM in openavc/core/project_loader.py); the panel
(web/panel/modules/clock.js, through modules/project_values.js) draws it and the
Format box's placeholder, both from the generated table.
tests/test_clock_format_parity.py runs every case through the table and the
panel, ClockFields.clock.test.tsx through the Builder. 'mode' is the clock's
clock_mode as written (absent when the key is missing); an 'expected' of null
is a mode that reads no format: a duration is always hours, minutes and
seconds, and the Builder shows no placeholder for it. A 'draft_only' case is
one the loader refuses, which only a Builder draft can hand the panel.

cases.name: a mode this release does not know
date in capitals is not date
a word that is an object's own property name
a number for a mode in a draft
